title: What a Quantum Field Is
summary: A quantum field assigns a quantum operator to every point in spacetime.
body:
Quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime. The Standard Model — built on QFT — predicts experimental results to staggering precision.

A quantum field assigns a quantum operator to every point in spacetime. Particles are quantized ripples: the electron field's excitations are electrons, the photon field's are photons. There is one electron field for the whole universe; every electron is a ripple in it.

facts: One field per particle species fills all of spacetime
Particles = quantized excitations (quanta) of their field
Fields obey relativity + quantum mechanics simultaneously
The vacuum is the field's lowest-energy state, not nothing

title: The Standard Model Particle Census
summary: The Standard Model has 17 fundamental particles: 6 quarks (up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom), 6 leptons (electron, muon, tau + 3 neutrinos), 4 force carriers (photon, gluon, W, Z), and the Higgs boson.
body:
The Standard Model has 17 fundamental particles: 6 quarks (up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom), 6 leptons (electron, muon, tau + 3 neutrinos), 4 force carriers (photon, gluon, W, Z), and the Higgs boson. Everything ever observed is built from these.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: 6 quarks, 6 leptons, 4 gauge bosons, 1 Higgs = 17
Quarks feel all forces; leptons skip the strong force
Only up/down quarks and electrons make ordinary matter
The top quark weighs ~173 GeV — as much as a gold atom

title: Feynman Diagrams: Calculation as Drawing
summary: Richard Feynman turned impossible integrals into doodles: lines for particles, vertices for interactions.
body:
Richard Feynman turned impossible integrals into doodles: lines for particles, vertices for interactions. Each diagram is a term in a perturbation series; adding more loops means more precision. The electron's magnetic moment matches experiment to 12 decimal places.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Each diagram = one term in a series expansion
More loops = more precision (and more diagrams)
The g-2 prediction is physics' most precise
Vertices encode the interaction strengths

title: Gauge Symmetry: The Deep Principle
summary: The Standard Model is built on gauge symmetry: physics is unchanged by local phase rotations, and demanding this forces the existence of force-carrying fields.
body:
The Standard Model is built on gauge symmetry: physics is unchanged by local phase rotations, and demanding this forces the existence of force-carrying fields. Electromagnetism comes from U(1) symmetry; the weak force from SU(2); the strong force from SU(3).

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: U(1) x SU(2) x SU(3) = the Standard Model's symmetry
Symmetry demands the force carriers exist
Gauge theories are renormalizable (proven 1971, 't Hooft)
The photon is the U(1) gauge boson

title: Renormalization: Taming Infinities
summary: QFT calculations produce infinities; renormalization absorbs them into measured quantities like charge and mass.
body:
QFT calculations produce infinities; renormalization absorbs them into measured quantities like charge and mass. What looked like cheating proved to be deep: couplings 'run' with energy, and the technique earned the 1965 Nobel Prize.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Infinities absorbed into physical parameters
Couplings change with energy scale (running)
QED's running coupling confirmed at LEP
Wilson reframed it as effective field theory

title: The Higgs Mechanism
summary: The Higgs field fills space with a nonzero value; particles wading through it gain mass.
body:
The Higgs field fills space with a nonzero value; particles wading through it gain mass. The 2012 ATLAS/CMS discovery of the 125 GeV Higgs boson completed the Standard Model and earned the 2013 Nobel Prize.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Higgs boson mass: ~125 GeV
Field's vacuum value: 246 GeV
Explains W/Z masses, not all mass (most is QCD binding)
2013 Nobel: Englert and Higgs

title: Quantum Chromodynamics (QCD)
summary: QCD describes quarks and gluons with SU(3) 'color' charge.
body:
QCD describes quarks and gluons with SU(3) 'color' charge. Its quirks: asymptotic freedom (quarks act free at high energy — 2004 Nobel) and confinement (quarks never appear alone). Most of your mass is QCD binding energy, not the Higgs.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Gluons carry color and self-interact
Confinement: no free quarks ever observed
Asymptotic freedom: 2004 Nobel (Gross, Politzer, Wilczek)
~99% of proton mass is binding energy

title: Quantum Electrodynamics (QED)
summary: QED is the most precise theory ever: it predicts the electron's magnetic moment to 1 part in 10^12.
body:
QED is the most precise theory ever: it predicts the electron's magnetic moment to 1 part in 10^12. Photons mediate the electromagnetic force between charged particles, and the theory's success set the template for all QFT.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Most precisely tested theory in science
Fine-structure constant alpha ~ 1/137.036
Lamb shift (1947) proved vacuum effects real
Feynman, Schwinger, Tomonaga: 1965 Nobel

title: The Path Integral
summary: Feynman's path integral says a particle takes every possible path at once, each weighted by a phase; the paths interfere, leaving the classical trajectory dominant.
body:
Feynman's path integral says a particle takes every possible path at once, each weighted by a phase; the paths interfere, leaving the classical trajectory dominant. It reformulates all of quantum mechanics — and underlies modern QFT computation.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Sum over all paths, weighted by exp(iS/hbar)
Classical path emerges by interference
Basis of lattice QFT simulations
Equivalent to Schrodinger/Heisenberg pictures

title: Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking
summary: A symmetric theory can have asymmetric ground states — like a pencil balanced on its tip falling one way.
body:
A symmetric theory can have asymmetric ground states — like a pencil balanced on its tip falling one way. This breaking gives the W/Z bosons mass via the Higgs and explains magnetism, superconductivity, and the early universe's phase transitions.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Symmetric laws, asymmetric vacuum
Goldstone bosons appear when continuous symmetries break
Higgs mechanism = gauged symmetry breaking
Early-universe phase transitions shaped cosmology

title: Anomalies: Quantum Rule-Breaking
summary: Some classical symmetries fail at the quantum level — anomalies.
body:
Some classical symmetries fail at the quantum level — anomalies. Far from a flaw, anomaly cancellation constrains which theories can exist: the Standard Model's particle content is partly fixed by demanding anomalies cancel.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Chiral anomaly: pions decay because of it
Anomaly cancellation fixes fermion content
Green-Schwarz mechanism saved string theory (1984)
't Hooft anomaly matching constrains low-energy physics

title: Effective Field Theory
summary: Kenneth Wilson's reframing: every QFT is valid up to some energy scale, with unknown high-energy physics packed into a few parameters.
body:
Kenneth Wilson's reframing: every QFT is valid up to some energy scale, with unknown high-energy physics packed into a few parameters. This is why the Standard Model works brilliantly despite being incomplete — and how we search beyond it.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: All theories are effective below some scale
Nonrenormalizable terms suppressed by the high scale
Fermi's weak theory = effective theory of the Standard Model
Guides beyond-Standard-Model searches

title: Lattice QFT: Computing the Strong Force
summary: Lattice QCD discretizes spacetime into a grid and simulates quarks numerically on supercomputers.
body:
Lattice QCD discretizes spacetime into a grid and simulates quarks numerically on supercomputers. It computes hadron masses from first principles — predicting the proton's mass to a few percent — no small feat for a theory once thought incalculable.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Spacetime becomes a 4D grid
Proton mass computed to ~2% accuracy
Requires exascale computing
Kenneth Wilson's 1974 invention

title: The Vacuum Is Not Empty
summary: QFT's vacuum seethes with virtual particles — confirmed by the Casimir effect (attraction between close plates, measured 1997) and the Lamb shift.
body:
QFT's vacuum seethes with virtual particles — confirmed by the Casimir effect (attraction between close plates, measured 1997) and the Lamb shift. Vacuum energy also drives the cosmological constant problem: theory overshoots observation by 10^120.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Casimir effect measured: vacuum pushes plates together
Lamb shift: vacuum shifts atomic levels
Cosmological constant problem: 10^120 discrepancy
Hawking radiation = vacuum effects at black holes

title: Scattering Amplitudes
summary: The S-matrix encodes what goes in and comes out of collisions.
body:
The S-matrix encodes what goes in and comes out of collisions. Modern amplitude methods (twistors, unitarity cuts) compute LHC predictions far faster than Feynman diagrams — a quiet revolution in how QFT calculates.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Amplitudes = probabilities for scattering outcomes
BCFW recursion (2004) simplified calculations
Drives LHC background predictions
Amplituhedron: geometry behind amplitudes (Arkani-Hamed)

title: Topological Terms and Theta Vacua
summary: QFT allows topological terms like QCD's theta angle — which would violate CP symmetry but is measured below 10^-10, the strong CP problem.
body:
QFT allows topological terms like QCD's theta angle — which would violate CP symmetry but is measured below 10^-10, the strong CP problem. Axions, invented to solve it, are now leading dark-matter candidates.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Strong CP problem: theta < 10^-10, unexplained
Axions proposed 1977 (Peccei-Quinn)
Axion searches: ADMX and successors
Topology classifies field configurations

title: QFT in Curved Spacetime
summary: Putting QFT on curved backgrounds predicts Hawking radiation (black holes evaporate) and cosmic inflation's quantum seeds (which became galaxies).
body:
Putting QFT on curved backgrounds predicts Hawking radiation (black holes evaporate) and cosmic inflation's quantum seeds (which became galaxies). It is the bridge between quantum theory and gravity — incomplete, but extraordinarily fruitful.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Hawking radiation: black holes have temperature
Unruh effect: acceleration looks like heat
Inflation's fluctuations seeded galaxies
Information paradox still unresolved

title: Beyond the Standard Model: The Open List
summary: QFT frames the open questions: the hierarchy problem (why is the Higgs so light?), dark matter's identity, neutrino masses, and quantum gravity.
body:
QFT frames the open questions: the hierarchy problem (why is the Higgs so light?), dark matter's identity, neutrino masses, and quantum gravity. Supersymmetry, extra dimensions, and composite Higgs are candidate answers being tested.

Context: this record is part of the Quantum Field Theory catalog — quantum field theory is the language of fundamental physics: particles are excitations of fields filling spacetime.
facts: Hierarchy problem: Higgs mass unstable to quantum corrections
Neutrino masses prove beyond-Standard-Model physics
Dark matter: no Standard Model candidate
Quantum gravity: QFT + GR still unreconciled
